QuestInfo.name: Tree Medicine
QuestInfo.0: Speak with Sabitrama the herb specialist.
QuestInfo.1: Sabitrama needs #b1 Ellivera Fruit#k from the plants the bloom in the fields of #b#m101020000##k. \r\nEllivera plants #i4032206# must be hit with regular attacks to drop their fruit. They can be a little hard to spot, so search carefully.
QuestInfo.2: You found and delivered the #bEllivera Fruit#k to Sabitrama.
QuestInfo.rewardSummary:
#Wbasic#
#fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0# 3,500
Can proceed to Not Quite Explorer Material

0.0: You seek... medicine for a tree in great pain. What do you mean, why am I peeking in your quest log? The important thing is that I have the skills to concoct your medicine, and I'm only missing one ingredient! Will you retrieve it?

yes.0: Find a special type of plant #i4032206# that grows in #b#m101020000##k, north of Ellinia. It is a shy plant, so search with an open heart and it will reveal itself to you.
yes.1: Once you find it, hit it with regular attacks to bloom #b1 Ellivera Fruit#k and bring it back to me.

no.0: The forests weep for the coldness in your soul.

1.0: Ah, you have the medici-- the Ellivera Fruit. Let me see it.

yes.0: Give me a moment to squeeze its juice into a spray bottle... All done!

item.0: The plant eludes you? Go north from Ellinia to #b#m101020000##k and dig through the grass until you find it. Then, whack it with normal attacks until it gives up its fruit.
